source.title: Call for Applicants - WRC Members (January 2024)
source.content:
The WCA Regulations Committee (WRC) is looking for new members. Interested community members of all backgrounds are encouraged to apply. The applications are open to everyone; it’s not a requirement to hold a current position in the WCA to be considered.

**What does the WRC do?**

* Update and improve the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). (See our public [GitHub repository](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations) and the [WCA Forum page](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/c/regulations/5).)
* Read competition reports and respond to incidents. 
* Engage with the WCA community for feedback about the Regulations. 
* Address any issues and inquiries related to the Regulations.

The official rights and duties of the WRC are documented in [WCA Motion 10.2021.9](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents).
<!-- break -->
**The qualities and requirements expected of candidates are:**

* Regularly check and respond to emails (5-10 emails/day). 
* Objectively apply the letter and spirit of the WCA Regulations. 
* Compassionately and constructively discuss how to address incidents. 
* Time commitment of 5-10 hours per week. 

The following are not required, but it would be useful for new WRC members to have additional experience with any of the following:

* Writing fluent, clear English while communicating across language differences. 
* Cubing community discussions, online or offline.
* The history of the WCA Regulations.
* Using GitHub and/or writing code (especially Python, JavaScript, Java, Ruby on Rails).
* Project management, leadership, addressing organizational incentives, advocacy, and/or legal work.

The priority application period is open for candidates to submit their candidacy document from now until **February 4th, 2024, 23:59 UTC privately to Antonio Kam ([akam@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:akam@worldcubeassociation.org))**. Candidacy documents must be in **PDF format**, and must include:

* A brief personal introduction. 
* A summary of experiences/accomplishments to demonstrate that you can meet the requirements.
* What motivates you to join the WRC? 
* Do you have any topics/issues that you are passionate about helping the WRC improve? 
* Optionally, any additional experience that is relevant to WRC work.

You can expect a reply to confirm whether your application is complete, and may receive a request for an interview with the WRC.

If you have any questions please do not hesitate in reaching out to Antonio Kam ([akam@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:akam@worldcubeassociation.org)).

Thank you for your interest in assisting the WRC and the WCA!

translation.title: WCA 规则委员会成员招募（2024 年 1 月）
translation.content:
WCA 规则委员会（WRC）正在招募新成员。欢迎各种背景的社区成员申请。申请面向所有人开放，无须已在 WCA 任职。

**WRC 的工作是什么？**

* 更新和完善《[WCA 规则](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)》。（参见我们的公开 [GitHub 仓库](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations)和 [WCA 论坛板块](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/c/regulations/5)。）
* 阅读比赛报告，处理意外事件。
* 与 WCA 社区交流，收集对规则的意见。
* 处理与规则有关的问题和咨询。

WRC 的正式权利和职责见 [WCA 决议 10.2021.9](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents)。

<!-- break -->

**我们希望申请人满足以下条件：**

* 经常查阅并回复邮件（每天约 5–10 封）。
* 客观地依照 WCA 规则的条文及精神作出判断。
* 讨论事件处理办法时，能体谅他人，并提出建设性的意见。
* 每周能投入 5–10 小时。

以下不是硬性要求，但具备其中任一方面的经验，将有助于开展 WRC 的工作：

* 在跨语言沟通中使用流畅、清楚的书面英语。
* 参与线上或线下魔方社区讨论。
* 了解 WCA 规则的历史。
* 使用 GitHub 及/或编程（尤其是 Python、JavaScript、Java、Ruby on Rails）。
* 项目管理、领导工作、处理组织激励问题、倡议推广及/或法律工作。

优先申请期为即日起至 **2024 年 2 月 4 日 23:59 UTC，请将材料私下发送给 Antonio Kam（[akam@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:akam@worldcubeassociation.org)）**。申请材料须为 **PDF 格式**，包含：

* 简短的自我介绍。
* 能证明自己满足要求的经历或成果总结。
* 申请加入 WRC 的原因。
* 是否有特别希望协助 WRC 改善的议题或问题。
* （可选）其他与 WRC 工作相关的经验。

我们会回复确认材料是否完整，也可能邀请你参加 WRC 面试。

如有疑问，欢迎联系 Antonio Kam（[akam@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:akam@worldcubeassociation.org)）。

感谢你愿意帮助 WRC 和 WCA！
